# Uniview NetDEVSDK Android

Official Network Device SDK V2.7.0.1 downloaded from Uniview resource id
`1638387` on 2026-10-27 after accepting the vendor software license for
internal non-commercial testing.

Only `arm64-v8a`, `armeabi-v7a`, the Java JNI bindings, documentation, and
selected demo sources are retained under `sdk/`. Do not redistribute these
vendor binaries separately from their license terms.
